main_text.head: CAP. XII.
De supplicio Bagathan & Tharez, & Iudæorum patientia sub Assuero.
main_text.p: Restant adhuc è canonicis Scriptu-ris Testamenti veteris exempla duo, & duo tantùm, è libro Esther deprompta utraque. Unum iusti supplicij in perduelles; inviolatæ in Regem obedientiæ alterum. Quod itaque ad primum attinet, eo tempore quo Af-fuerus (quem Artaxerxem appellat Josephus) captiuos sub ditione sua detinuit, Judæos, ad januam Regis morabatur Mordocheus natione Judæus, ubi forte subodorans duos Regis Eunuchos, Bagathan & Tharez furoris œstro aduersus Regem percitos, in ipsius internecionem coniurasse, statim ut rescis-ceret,

page.notes: Printed spelling "Af-fuerus" with hyphen at line end is as printed; the printer's text otherwise reads "Assuerus". The line "rescis-ceret," is split across the line end as printed. The decorative bullet above "Restant" is not text and was left out. Long s is normalised to s throughout; u/v and i/j are normalised per the rules.
